_about: Shapes of Tokenetes Transaction Tokens and requests, reproduced from Tokenetes source. Values are illustrative; no Tokenetes key material is copied. Tests re-sign these shapes with freshly generated keys. '<now>' and '<now + N>' are resolved at test time; '<uuid>' becomes a random UUID string.

token._source: tokenetes service/pkg/service/service.go GenerateTxnToken: jwt.SigningMethodRS256, Header typ = TOKEN_JWT_HEADER ('txn_token'), kid = keys.GetKid(); claims iss, iat, aud, exp, txn (uuid), sub, purp, azd, rctx. service/pkg/keys/keys.go: kid = base64.StdEncoding of 16 random bytes, RSA-2048 key generated at process start.

_claims_source.iss/aud/exp: TokenetesConfig spec.token.issuer / audience / lifeTime (example-application deploy/alpha-stocks-dev/tokenetes-resources/tokenetescfg.yaml: lifeTime '15s'). Hostnames changed to .example.
_claims_source.sub: service/pkg/subjectidentifier/subjectidentifier.go: OIDC subjects become {format: email, email}; self-signed subjects copy the subject token's 'sub' verbatim (selfSignedTokenHandler.go ExtractSubject), so a string is also possible.
_claims_source.purp/azd: service/pkg/generationrules/v1alpha1/rules.go ConstructPurpAndAzd; azd is null when the TraT rule has no azdMapping. Mapping from example-application stock-trade-api-trat.yaml.
_claims_source.rctx: Copied verbatim from the caller's base64url request_context (service/handler/handler.go). example-application gateway sends {req_ip}.

jwks._source: tokenetes service/pkg/keys/keys.go generateKeys: jwk.New(rsa public), alg RS256, use sig, kid. Served only over the tconfigd WebSocket (GET_JWKS_REQUEST), never over HTTP.

token_request._source: tokenetes service/handler/handler.go TokenEndpointHandler (POST /token_endpoint on :443, SPIFFE mTLS, caller SPIFFE ID must be in tokenGenerationAuthorizedServiceIds).
token_request.request_details_encoding: base64url (unpadded) JSON {path, method, queryParameters, headers, body}

agent_claims._source: tokenetes-agent service/trat/trat.go: TraT{txn string, sub {format, email}, req_ctx {req_ip, authn, req_wl []string}, purp string, azd map, jwt.StandardClaims}; service/tratverifier/tratverifier.go accepts only *jwt.SigningMethodRSA (RS256/384/512) and requires kid; typ is never checked.
